panels.title: Active Users (window)
panels.description: Distinct users who made an LLM call in the window (unified definition).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS active_users
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION'
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))

panels.title: New Users (this period)
panels.description: Number of users whose first appearance falls inside this time window

targets.rawSql:
WITH all_first AS (
  SELECT user_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen
  FROM traces WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT count(*) AS new_users
FROM all_first
WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen)

panels.title: Avg Sessions / User
panels.description: Avg sessions per user. Low = drive-by; high = heavy use.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(count(DISTINCT session_id) / nullIf(count(DISTINCT user_id), 0), 1) AS avg_sessions
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)

panels.title: WAU / MAU (Stickiness)
panels.description: WAU/MAU ratio: >50% is the stickiness baseline for sticky products. **Note**: early-stage products have a small MAU denominator and an unstable ratio — wait until you have 60+ days of history.

targets.rawSql:
WITH wau AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS u FROM traces
                  WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
                    AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)),
     mau AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS u FROM traces
             WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
               AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment))
SELECT round((SELECT u FROM wau) * 100.0 / nullIf((SELECT u FROM mau), 0), 1) AS stickiness_pct

panels.title: Avg Cost / User
panels.description: Cost per user. Pair with output metrics to read ROI.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) / nullIf(count(DISTINCT t.user_id), 0), 2) AS cost_per_user
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))

options.content:
**Use quality metrics, not commits**:
- `commits` is too easy to game (a one-line change is still 1 commit).
- `PR` is a higher-level output unit, but **current telemetry doesn't record PR-merge status** — PR pass rate is a placeholder.
- `Accepted Edits` comes from `tool_decisions.accept` — the real acceptance rate of Claude's suggestions and the most direct reflection of value.

Telemetry suggestion: emit PR-merge events into `metadata['pr_merged']` from a git hook so this dashboard can compute pass rate.

panels.title: PRs / User (this period)
panels.description: PRs created per user

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['pr_count'])) * 1.0 /
       nullIf(count(DISTINCT user_id), 0), 2) AS prs_per_user
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)

panels.title: PR Pass Rate (telemetry pending)
panels.description: Placeholder: telemetry has no PR-merge status yet. Need git hook to emit metadata['pr_merged']=true.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 0 AS pass_rate

panels.title: Accepted Edits / User
panels.description: Accepted Claude suggestions per user

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) * 1.0 /
       nullIf(count(DISTINCT user_id), 0), 1) AS accepts_per_user
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)

panels.title: Team Total Accepted Edits
panels.description: Team total output in the window (accepted code suggestions)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS total_accepts
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)

panels.title: Top Contributors (by Accepted Edits)
panels.description: Ranked by contribution. Manager sees at a glance where the team's output comes from.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  user_id AS user,
  sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepted_edits,
  sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')) AS rejected,
  sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['pr_count'])) AS prs,
  sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['commit_count'])) AS commits,
  sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['tool_count'])) AS tool_calls,
  count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
  round(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) * 100.0 /
        nullIf(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') + JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')), 0),
        1) AS accept_rate_pct
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY user
ORDER BY accepted_edits DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Team Daily Contribution (accepts / commits / PRs)
panels.description: Per-day team-wide totals of accepted edits, commits, and PRs. Trend up = team output ramping.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS time,
  sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts,
  sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['commit_count'])) AS commits,
  sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['pr_count'])) AS prs
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Daily Active Users
panels.description: DAU trend

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDate(timestamp) AS time,
  count(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cumulative Users Growth
panels.description: Cumulative new-users curve. Slope reflects rollout velocity.

targets.rawSql:
WITH user_first AS (
  SELECT user_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen FROM traces
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
  toDate(first_seen) AS time,
  count(*) AS new_users,
  sum(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY toDate(first_seen)) AS cumulative_users
FROM user_first
WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Avg Sessions per User per Day
panels.description: Sessions per user per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDate(timestamp) AS time,
  round(count(DISTINCT session_id) * 1.0 / nullIf(count(DISTINCT user_id), 0), 2) AS sessions_per_user
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Accept Rate Trend (Team)
panels.description: Team-wide accept-rate trend — change in trust level

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDate(timestamp) AS time,
  round(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) * 100.0 /
        nullIf(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') + JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')), 0), 2) AS accept_rate_pct
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND metadata['tool_decisions'] != ''
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Avg Tool Calls per Session
panels.description: avg / p95 reflect session-complexity trend. Sudden spikes = harder tasks or inefficient tool calls. Persistently low (<3) = simple tasks; users may be under-utilizing Claude Code.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDate(timestamp) AS time,
  round(avg(toInt32OrZero(metadata['tool_count'])), 1) AS avg_tools,
  round(quantile(0.95)(toInt32OrZero(metadata['tool_count'])), 1) AS p95_tools
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: New User Time-to-First-Commit
panels.description: Time from a new user's first appearance to first commit. Short = quick value; NULL = used but did not commit (thinker).

targets.rawSql:
WITH first_event AS (
  SELECT user_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen FROM traces
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  GROUP BY user_id
),
first_commit AS (
  SELECT user_id, min(timestamp) AS first_commit_at FROM traces
  WHERE toInt32OrZero(metadata['commit_count']) > 0 AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
  fe.user_id AS user,
  toString(fe.first_seen) AS first_seen,
  toString(fc.first_commit_at) AS first_commit,
  case
    when fc.first_commit_at IS NULL then -1
    when fc.first_commit_at < fe.first_seen then 0
    else dateDiff('hour', fe.first_seen, fc.first_commit_at)
  end AS hours_to_first_commit
FROM first_event fe LEFT JOIN first_commit fc ON fe.user_id = fc.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(fe.first_seen)
ORDER BY fe.first_seen DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Active Days in 7-Day Window (distribution)
panels.description: Active-days-out-of-7 per user. 1 day = drive-by (churn risk); 6-7 days = heavy dependence.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  active_days_bucket,
  count(*) AS user_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    case
      when active_days = 1 then '1 day (drive-by)'
      when active_days = 2 then '2 days'
      when active_days = 3 then '3 days'
      when active_days <= 5 then '4-5 days'
      else '6-7 days (engaged)'
    end AS active_days_bucket,
    multiIf(active_days=1, 1, active_days=2, 2, active_days=3, 3,
            active_days<=5, 4, 5) AS bucket_order
  FROM (
    SELECT user_id, count(DISTINCT toDate(timestamp)) AS active_days
    FROM traces
    WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
      AND user_id IS NOT NULL
      AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
    GROUP BY user_id
  )
)
GROUP BY active_days_bucket, bucket_order
ORDER BY bucket_order

panels.title: Activation Rate
panels.description: Share of new users who produced valid output (commit OR accept). **Manager tip**: demo/test users (demo*) will drag this down; exclude them via the top user filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH all_first AS (
  SELECT user_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen
  FROM traces
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id
),
new_users AS (
  SELECT user_id FROM all_first
  WHERE first_seen >= $__fromTime AND first_seen <= $__toTime
),
activated AS (
  SELECT t.user_id FROM traces t
  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.timestamp) AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (toInt32OrZero(t.metadata['commit_count']) > 0
         OR JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') > 0)
  GROUP BY t.user_id
)
SELECT round(count(DISTINCT a.user_id) * 100.0 / nullIf(count(DISTINCT n.user_id), 0), 1)
       AS activation_pct
FROM new_users n LEFT JOIN activated a ON n.user_id = a.user_id

panels.title: Drive-by Users (1 day)
panels.description: Users active only 1 of the last 7 days (churn risk). Current threshold is fixed; consider customizing it as a 30%/50% ratio of team size. Team size: $team_size.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS one_day_users
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, count(DISTINCT toDate(timestamp)) AS d
  FROM traces
  WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
  GROUP BY user_id HAVING d = 1
)

panels.title: Engaged Users (6-7 days)
panels.description: Heavy users active 6-7 of the last 7 days. Team size: $team_size; ideal is >50%.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS engaged_users
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, count(DISTINCT toDate(timestamp)) AS d
  FROM traces
  WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
  GROUP BY user_id HAVING d >= 6
)

panels.title: New-User Retention Curve (D1 / D7 / D30)
panels.description: Of users first seen N days ago, the share who returned on D1, D7, and D30. Cohorted by first-appearance day. D1 = next-day return, D7 = same weekday, D30 = month-later return. Lower curves = leaky onboarding.

targets.rawSql:
WITH first_seen AS (
  SELECT user_id, toDate(min(timestamp)) AS d0
  FROM traces
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  GROUP BY user_id
),
returns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, toDate(timestamp) AS d
  FROM traces
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)
SELECT
  toDateTime(fs.d0) AS time,
  countIf(r1.user_id IS NOT NULL) * 100.0 / nullIf(count(*), 0) AS d1_retention_pct,
  countIf(r7.user_id IS NOT NULL) * 100.0 / nullIf(count(*), 0) AS d7_retention_pct,
  countIf(r30.user_id IS NOT NULL) * 100.0 / nullIf(count(*), 0) AS d30_retention_pct
FROM first_seen fs
LEFT JOIN returns r1  ON r1.user_id  = fs.user_id AND r1.d  = fs.d0 + 1
LEFT JOIN returns r7  ON r7.user_id  = fs.user_id AND r7.d  = fs.d0 + 7
LEFT JOIN returns r30 ON r30.user_id = fs.user_id AND r30.d = fs.d0 + 30
WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(fs.d0))
GROUP BY fs.d0
ORDER BY fs.d0

panels.title: Why a leaderboard, not a radar

options.content: Radar charts look pretty, but managers need to make quick decisions about "who is top contributor", "who is growing fast", "who is exiting". A leaderboard table — one user per row, sorted by metric — is more actionable than an abstract 'maturity score'.

panels.title: Growth Users (this period vs prior)
panels.description: Accepted edits this period vs prior. Green = growing users; red = declining users.

targets.rawSql:
WITH curr AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
    sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts
  FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
  GROUP BY user_id
),
prev AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
    sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts
  FROM traces
  WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime - (toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))
    AND timestamp < $__fromTime
    AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
  c.user_id AS user,
  c.accepts AS accepts_now,
  coalesce(p.accepts, 0) AS accepts_prev,
  c.accepts - coalesce(p.accepts, 0) AS delta,
  case
    when coalesce(p.accepts, 0) = 0 AND c.accepts > 0 then 'NEW'
    when coalesce(p.accepts, 0) > 0 then toString(round((c.accepts - p.accepts) * 100.0 / p.accepts, 0)) || '%'
    else '-'
  end AS growth_pct
FROM curr c LEFT JOIN prev p ON c.user_id = p.user_id
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: At-Risk Users (declining this period)
panels.description: Users with falling session counts vs prior period. Manager should proactively reach out to CHURNED / DECLINING users. (Note: prior window must have data to compare; freshly deployed environments may be empty for the first 30 days.)

targets.rawSql:
WITH curr AS (
  SELECT user_id, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions FROM traces
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
  GROUP BY user_id
),
prev AS (
  SELECT user_id, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions FROM traces
  WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime - (toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))
    AND timestamp < $__fromTime
    AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
  coalesce(c.user_id, p.user_id) AS user,
  coalesce(c.sessions, 0) AS sessions_now,
  coalesce(p.sessions, 0) AS sessions_prev,
  coalesce(c.sessions, 0) - coalesce(p.sessions, 0) AS delta,
  case
    when coalesce(c.sessions, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(p.sessions, 0) > 0 then 'CHURNED'
    when coalesce(c.sessions, 0) < coalesce(p.sessions, 0) * 0.5 then 'DECLINING'
    when coalesce(c.sessions, 0) < coalesce(p.sessions, 0) then 'SLIGHT_DROP'
    else '-'
  end AS status
FROM prev p LEFT JOIN curr c ON p.user_id = c.user_id
WHERE coalesce(p.sessions, 0) > 0
  AND coalesce(c.sessions, 0) < coalesce(p.sessions, 0)
ORDER BY delta ASC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Model Preference per User
panels.description: Per-user model preference. One user always on Opus while others find Sonnet sufficient = a training nudge.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.user_id AS user,
  round(toFloat64(sumIf(o.effective_cost, o.provided_model_name LIKE '%opus%')), 2) AS opus_cost,
  round(toFloat64(sumIf(o.effective_cost, o.provided_model_name LIKE '%sonnet%')), 2) AS sonnet_cost,
  round(toFloat64(sumIf(o.effective_cost, o.provided_model_name LIKE '%haiku%')), 2) AS haiku_cost,
  round(toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)), 2) AS total
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
GROUP BY user
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Tool Usage Profile per User
panels.description: Per-user tool-usage profile. Spot 'power users' (sub-agent / MCP) vs ordinary users (Bash/Read/Edit only).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.user_id AS user,
  countIf(has(o.tool_call_names, 'Bash')) AS bash,
  countIf(has(o.tool_call_names, 'Read')) AS read_,
  countIf(has(o.tool_call_names, 'Edit')) AS edit_,
  countIf(has(o.tool_call_names, 'Write')) AS write_,
  countIf(has(o.tool_call_names, 'Agent')) AS sub_agent,
  countIf(arrayExists(x -> x LIKE 'mcp__%', o.tool_call_names)) AS mcp_calls
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND length(o.tool_call_names) > 0
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
GROUP BY user
ORDER BY (bash + read_ + edit_ + write_) DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Active Days Leaderboard (LCD)
panels.description: User active-days leaderboard (LCD bargauge, capped at 7 days / window).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  user_id AS user,
  count(DISTINCT toDate(timestamp)) AS active_days
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY user
ORDER BY active_days DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Related Dashboards (Claude Code)
panels.description: Quick jump to the other Claude Code dashboards

panels.title: Activity Heatmap (Hour × Day)
panels.description: Team work rhythm. Darker = higher activity. Identifies normal hours and anomalous windows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime(toString(toDate(timestamp)) || ' ' || lpad(toString(toHour(timestamp)), 2, '0') || ':00:00')) AS time,
  toString(toHour(timestamp)) AS hour,
  count(*) AS activity
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY toDate(timestamp), hour, time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cost per Accepted Edit (by user)
panels.description: Spend per accept. High = lots of thinking with few accepts; low = efficient user.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.user_id AS user,
  toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS total_cost,
  sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepted_edits,
  toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) / nullIf(sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')), 0) AS cost_per_accept,
  count(DISTINCT t.session_id) AS sessions
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
GROUP BY user
HAVING accepted_edits > 0
ORDER BY cost_per_accept DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Tool Error Rate by User (error-prone users)
panels.description: High-error users = hard tasks or low proficiency. Consider training.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  user_id AS user,
  sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['tool_count'])) AS total_tools,
  sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['tool_error_count'])) AS errors,
  round(sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['tool_error_count'])) * 100.0 /
        nullIf(sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['tool_count'])), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND metadata['tool_count'] != ''
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY user
HAVING total_tools > 5
ORDER BY error_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Onboarding Milestones (activation pace)
panels.description: Hours from a new user's first use to first accept / commit / PR. HR cares about onboarding experience.

targets.rawSql:
WITH user_events AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    min(timestamp) AS first_seen,
    minIf(timestamp, JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') > 0) AS first_accept,
    minIf(timestamp, toInt32OrZero(metadata['commit_count']) > 0) AS first_commit,
    minIf(timestamp, toInt32OrZero(metadata['pr_count']) > 0) AS first_pr
  FROM traces WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
  user_id AS user,
  toString(first_seen) AS first_use,
  if(first_accept IS NULL OR first_accept < first_seen, NULL, dateDiff('hour', first_seen, first_accept)) AS hours_to_first_accept,
  if(first_commit IS NULL OR first_commit < first_seen, NULL, dateDiff('hour', first_seen, first_commit)) AS hours_to_first_commit,
  if(first_pr IS NULL OR first_pr < first_seen, NULL, dateDiff('hour', first_seen, first_pr)) AS hours_to_first_pr
FROM user_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen)
ORDER BY first_seen DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Tool Adoption Coverage (user coverage)
panels.description: What % of users have used each tool. Low coverage = training / rollout opportunity.

targets.rawSql:
WITH total_users AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS n
  FROM traces t WHERE $__timeFilter(t.timestamp) AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
)
SELECT
  arrayJoin(o.tool_call_names) AS tool,
  count(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS users_using,
  round(count(DISTINCT t.user_id) * 100.0 / nullIf((SELECT n FROM total_users), 0), 1) AS adoption_pct
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND length(o.tool_call_names) > 0
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
GROUP BY tool
ORDER BY adoption_pct DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: User Tier Distribution
panels.description: Power: ≥100 traces OR ≥50 accepts | Regular: 20-100 | Casual: <20

targets.rawSql:
WITH user_activity AS (
  SELECT user_id, count() AS traces, sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts
  FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
  countIf(traces >= 100 OR accepts >= 50) AS power_users,
  countIf(traces >= 20 AND traces < 100 AND accepts < 50) AS regular_users,
  countIf(traces < 20) AS casual_users
FROM user_activity

panels.title: Inactive Users (no activity this week)
panels.description: Users seen in last 30d but inactive this week (7d). Manager proactive-outreach targets.

targets.rawSql:
WITH all_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM traces
  WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
),
active_recent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM traces
  WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)
SELECT
  au.user_id AS user,
  toString(maxIf(timestamp, true)) AS last_seen,
  dateDiff('day', max(timestamp), now()) AS days_inactive
FROM all_users au
INNER JOIN traces t ON au.user_id = t.user_id
LEFT JOIN active_recent ar ON au.user_id = ar.user_id
WHERE ar.user_id IS NULL
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY au.user_id
ORDER BY days_inactive ASC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Code Language Profile (by user)
panels.description: Code-file-type distribution touched per user. Reveals specialty (frontend / backend / DevOps).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.user_id AS user,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.py') AS python,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.js'
       OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.ts'
       OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.tsx'
       OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.jsx') AS js_ts,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.go') AS go_,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.rs') AS rust,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.java'
       OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.kt') AS java_kt,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.md') AS markdown,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.json'
       OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.yaml'
       OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.yml') AS config_
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.name IN ('Tool: Read', 'Tool: Edit', 'Tool: Write')
  AND JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') != ''
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
GROUP BY user
HAVING (python + js_ts + go_ + rust + java_kt + markdown + config_) > 0
ORDER BY (python + js_ts + go_ + rust + java_kt + markdown + config_) DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Team Productivity Snapshot
panels.description: Quick view of the team's 5 key output indicators

targets.rawSql:
WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT
    sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS total_accepts,
    sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')) AS total_rejects,
    sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['commit_count'])) AS commits,
    sum(toInt32OrZero(metadata['pr_count'])) AS prs,
    count(DISTINCT user_id) AS users,
    count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
  FROM traces
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)
SELECT
  round(total_accepts * 100.0 / nullIf(total_accepts + total_rejects, 0), 2) AS accept_rate,
  round(total_accepts * 1.0 / nullIf(users, 0), 1) AS accepts_per_user,
  round(commits * 1.0 / nullIf(users, 0), 1) AS commits_per_user,
  round(prs * 1.0 / nullIf(users, 0), 1) AS prs_per_user,
  round(sessions * 1.0 / nullIf(users, 0), 1) AS sessions_per_user
FROM metrics

panels.title: Cost-Efficiency Trend (per Accept)
panels.description: Daily cost-per-accept trend. Falling = team getting more efficient; rising = config or behavior issue.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    toDate(o.start_time) AS day,
    toFloat64(sum(o.effective_cost)) AS cost,
    sum(JSONExtractInt(t.metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts
  FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'Execute evaluator%'
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT
  toDateTime(day) AS time,
  cost AS daily_cost,
  accepts AS daily_accepts,
  round(cost / nullIf(accepts, 0), 4) AS cost_per_accept
FROM daily
ORDER BY day

panels.title: User Persistence Score (last 7 days)
panels.description: Active days / 7 = persistence. >70% = heavy dependence; <30% = occasional use.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  user_id AS user,
  count(DISTINCT toDate(timestamp)) AS active_days,
  round(count(DISTINCT toDate(timestamp)) * 100.0 / 7, 0) AS persistence_pct,
  count(*) AS total_traces,
  count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM traces
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY user
ORDER BY active_days DESC, total_traces DESC
LIMIT 20
